WHAT IS THIS?
─────────────
Myasorubka is a fast-paced top-down shooter where time
slows down when you stand still and speeds up when you
move. Destroy enemies, collect new weapons, and defeat
bosses!


HOW TO RUN:
───────────

  Windows:
  ────────
  • Double-click play.bat
  • Or just open index.html in any browser

  macOS:
  ──────
  • Double-click play.command
  • Or just open index.html in Safari/Chrome

  Linux:
  ──────
  • Double-click play.sh
  • Or just open index.html in your browser

  Mobile:
  ───────
  Transfer index.html to your phone and open in browser.
  Works on iOS and Android!


CONTROLS:
─────────

  Keyboard + Mouse:
  • WASD / Arrow keys — move
  • Mouse — aim
  • Left click — shoot
  • R — reload
  • D — dash (unlocked later)
  • Space / Enter — start game

  Touch controls:
  • Left joystick — move
  • Tap screen — shoot
  • R button — reload
  • D button — dash


FEATURES:
─────────
  • 6 weapons: pistol, shotgun, SMG, LMG, bow, rocket
  • Infinite levels with increasing difficulty
  • Enemies: melee, shooters, tanks, and bosses
  • High score system (saved in browser)
  • Procedurally generated maps
  • Time slowdown mechanics


TIPS:
─────
  • Keep moving! Time only flows when you move
  • Use dash to dodge enemy bullets
  • Walls are your friends - use them for cover
  • New weapons unlock on waves 1, 3, 5, 7, 9
